description: At blend 0 the Limb ignores ikTarget and the toe is the FK toe, so a roll of 20 moves neither the hand nor the toe. The toe FK control turns the toe about its own Z (the world's, because Rz 90 keeps Z): 30 more makes Rz 120 at the toe, and the toe tip, offset (0, -0.1, 0.6), goes to (0.1 sin30, -0.1 cos30, 0.6) = (0.05, -0.086603, 0.6) from the toe.
